source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI), Adi Parva, Astika sub-parva, adhyayas 21–23: Kadru orders Vinata to carry her to Ramaniyaka, the serpents' island in the ocean, and Garuda to carry the serpents; he flies toward the Sun and the serpents faint in its heat; Kadru praises Indra (1.21), who covers the sky with clouds and rains (1.22); they reach Ramaniyaka; the serpents order Garuda to carry them on to another island; Garuda asks his mother why he must obey them, then asks the serpents what would set them free (1.23).
structure: From episode 11: COLD OPEN (the hook over the episode's strongest image, big on-screen text from frame 1; KIT.series.hookCard) → title (the hook's post) → RECAP (≈2.5 s) → STORY (with a brief cut to Sauti at the Naimisha fire) → the cliffhanger image + line → a silent ≈1.5 s Next card that dissolves back into the first frame (KIT.series.loopNextScene).

voice.note: speaker → script/cast.json (voice, speed, pitch). Per line: speed (× the speaker's), pre/post (ms of silence before/after the voice), say (what is spoken, if not `text`). captionY (px or "high") lifts the caption above low action.

lines.speaker: sauti
lines.text: Why would a mighty bird carry the serpents who enslaved his mother?
lines.say: Why would a mighty bird carry the serpents [p:60] who enslaved his mother?
lines.note: COLD OPEN (moving from frame 1): Garuda LARGE in flight over the sea, wings beating, serpents coiled on his back; the question in big text from frame 1.

lines.text: Garuda was born, and found his mother a slave.
lines.say: Garuda was born, [p:80] and found his mother a slave.
lines.note: RECAP: episode 19's image as a memory: Garuda bowing to Vinata on the shore.

lines.speaker: kadru
lines.text: "Vinata, carry me to Ramaniyaka. Your son will carry my sons."
lines.say: Vinata, [p:100] carry me to Ramaniyaka. [p:150] Your son will carry my sons.
lines.note: STORY 1 (Kadru speaks): the shore at morning; Kadru LARGE, imperious, pointing out to sea (beats[1]); then at Garuda and her sons (beats[3]). Name card for the island.

lines.text: Vinata bore Kadru. Garuda bore the serpents, out over the sea.
lines.say: Vinata bore Kadru. [p:120] Garuda bore the serpents, [p:80] out over the sea.
lines.note: STORY 2: wide over the ocean: Vinata flying with Kadru on her back, and above them Garuda with the serpents coiled on his back.

lines.text: Garuda flew higher, close to the Sun.
lines.say: Garuda flew higher, [p:80] close to the Sun.
lines.note: STORY 3: Garuda climbs toward a blazing Sun at the top of the frame; heat shimmer; the sky whitens.

lines.text: In the heat, the serpents fainted.
lines.say: In the heat, [p:150] the serpents fainted.
lines.note: STORY 4 · THE TURN (≈ 45 %): close on his back: the serpents' hoods droop and their rims dim one by one (beats[1]).

lines.speaker: kadru
lines.text: "Indra, lord of the gods, save my sons!"
lines.say: Indra, [p:100] lord of the gods, [p:100] save my sons!
lines.note: STORY 5 (Kadru speaks): Kadru, on Vinata's back, lifts her hands to the sky and cries out (her long praise of Indra in the CE, condensed).

lines.text: Indra covered the sky with clouds, and poured down rain.
lines.say: Indra covered the sky with clouds, [p:100] and poured down rain.
lines.note: STORY 6: Indra on his storm cloud (EP13.storm), vajra raised; clouds roll over the Sun (beats[1]), rain sweeps down (beats[2]); the serpents revive.

lines.speaker: sauti
lines.text: So they came to Ramaniyaka, a lovely island in the sea.
lines.say: So they came to Ramaniyaka, [p:80] a lovely island in the sea.
lines.note: FRAME (Sauti at the Naimisha fire, a ninth angle: low, between two sages); above the fire a gold-ringed medallion shows a green island ringed with surf (the island's name card).

lines.speaker: nagas
lines.text: "Bird, carry us to another island, with clear water!"
lines.say: Bird, [p:100] carry us to another island, [p:80] with clear water!
lines.note: STORY 7 (the serpents speak, as one): on the island's shore, the serpents rear round Garuda, ordering him; he stands among them, his wings half-folded, his eye burning.
NEXT 1 (cliffhanger image): Garuda turns to face the serpents, LARGE.

lines.speaker: garuda
lines.note: NEXT 2 (Garuda speaks): close on Garuda's eagle head, the fierce eye softening to a question; on 'freedom' (beats[1]) a single bell. (The catalog cliffhanger: the narrator line and Garuda's question.)
The short, silent Next card: a glimpse of episode 21: the serpents rearing, the white pot of amrita glowing far above; then the loop back to frame 1.
